- **Stmt 3:** |{s∈S : h(s) > min(B)}| > |{b∈B : h(b) > min(S)}|, i.e., S3_left > S3_right
- **Stmt 4:** avg(B) < avg(S)

## Statement 1 implies Statements 2, 3, and 4

**1→2:** If min(S) > max(B), then every blockhead has h < min(S), so B_short = b ≥ 1. No sky-scraper has h < max(B) (since min(S) > max(B)), so S_short = 0. Thus B_short = b > 0 = S_short. ✓

**1→4:** Every blockhead has h ≤ max(B) < min(S) ≤ every sky-scraper, so avg(B) ≤ max(B) < min(S) ≤ avg(S). ✓

## No other implications hold (counterexamples)

**2⇸4:** s=2, b=33. S={50, 51}, B={40×32, 1000}. B_short=32, S_short=2 → Stmt 2 true. avg(B)=2280/33≈69.1 > 50.5=avg(S) → Stmt 4 false.

**3⇸2:** s=30, b=5. S={100×29, 50}, B={60×5}. S3_left=29, S3_right=5 → Stmt 3 true. B_short=0, S_short=1 → 0>1 false → Stmt 2 false.

**3⇸4:** s=20, b=15. S={100×19, 50}, B={60, 200×14}. S3_left=19, S3_right=15 → Stmt 3 true. avg(B)=2860/15≈190.7 > 97.5=avg(S) → Stmt 4 false.

**4⇸2:** s=5, b=30. S={200, 50×4}, B={60×29, 10}. avg(B)=1750/30≈58.3 < 80=avg(S) → Stmt 4 true. B_short=1, S_short=4 → 1>4 false → Stmt 2 false.

**4⇸3:** Same example. S3_left=5 (all > 10), S3_right=29 (height 60 > 50) → 5>29 false → Stmt 3 false.

$$\sum_{i=1}^4 \sum_{j \neq i} a_{i,j} = 3$$
